question:
The bar graph given below shows the production of refrigerator by 6 companies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0bafc88355006380c5ea1566ee8e6eceed1138b14485332b4e7fdb6bb4ff383.png] 

The production of refrigerator by A is what percent of the production of refrigerator by E?
solution:
**Calculation:**

The production of refrigerator by A = 300

The production of refrigerator by E = 60

Percent of the production of refrigerator by A to The production of

refrigerator by E = 300/60 × 100 = 500 %

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
